question: How is the twenty-sixth section on ten-avatar mantras formally concluded and identified?
premises: The section is set in the Merutantra composed by Śiva.
It is approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla.
It is identified as the twenty-sixth exposition of ten-avatar mantras.
inference: Thus ends the twenty-sixth exposition of the ten-avatar mantras in the Merutantra, composed by Śiva and approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla.
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-sixth exposition of the mantras of the ten avatars in the Merutantra, composed by Śiva and approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla.
